Class OllamaTokenDip

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.OllamaTokenDip
final class OllamaTokenDip extends Object
The OllamaTokenDip type reads one settled token count from Ollama, the program that runs the model. The request is POST to HOST. The model name is deepseek-r1:7b. The option num_predict is 1. The method reads the reply only to take prompt_eval_count. The generated text in that reply is not kept. The failed call does not invoke OllamaTokenDip.Seat.settled(int). The caller then keeps the count it already has. The text longer than MAX_CHARS characters does not start a request. The empty text does not start a request. The type does not paint. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#OllamaTokenDip FINESSE:f-149

  • Constructor Details

    • OllamaTokenDip

      OllamaTokenDip(OllamaTokenDip.Seat seat)
      The constructor stores the callback and builds a one-shot timer. The timer waits 700 milliseconds. The timer does not repeat.
      Parameters:
      seat - The callback that receives a settled count.

  • Method Details

    • watch

      void watch(String text)
      The watch method arms a settle for this text. The method stores a null text as an empty string. The method returns without touching the timer when the text equals the text already pending. The method stores the text and adds one to the generation on every other call. The method stops the timer when the text is empty. The method stops the timer when the text is longer than MAX_CHARS. The method restarts the 700 millisecond timer for every other text.
      Parameters:
      text - The line or the counted body. The value may be null.

    • fire

      private void fire()
      The fire method starts one background read for the pending text. The method returns without a thread when the pending text is empty. The method returns without a thread when the pending text is longer than MAX_CHARS. The worker thread is a daemon named ollama-token-dip. The worker reads the count, then schedules the callback on the Swing event thread. The callback does nothing when the generation has changed. The callback does nothing when the count is under 1. The callback calls OllamaTokenDip.Seat.settled(int) for any other count.

    • readCount

      private static int readCount(String text)
      The readCount method posts the text and returns prompt_eval_count. The request method is POST. The connect timeout is 4000 milliseconds. The read timeout is 20000 milliseconds. The content type is application/json; charset=utf-8. The method returns 0 when the status is outside 200 through 299. The method returns 0 when the response stream is null. The method returns 0 when any exception is thrown. The connection is disconnected before the method returns.
      Parameters:
      text - The prompt text already checked for length.
      Returns:
      The return value is prompt_eval_count, or 0 on a miss.

    • bodyFor

      static String bodyFor(String text)
      The bodyFor method builds the JSON request body for one prompt. The model field is MODEL. The prompt field is the JSON string from jsonString(String). The stream field is false. The keep-alive field is 300. The option num_predict is 1.
      Parameters:
      text - The prompt text placed in the body.
      Returns:
      The return value is one JSON object.

    • jsonString

      static String jsonString(String text)
      The jsonString method wraps one prompt in JSON quotes. The method writes a backslash as two backslash characters. The method writes a quote as a backslash and the quote. The method writes a line feed as a backslash and n. The method writes a carriage return as a backslash and r. The method writes any other character under U+0020 as a space. The method writes every other character as itself.
      Parameters:
      text - The prompt text. The caller does not pass null.
      Returns:
      The return value is a quoted JSON string.

    • promptEvalCount

      static int promptEvalCount(String body)
      The promptEvalCount method reads prompt_eval_count from a reply body. The method returns 0 when the body is null. The method returns 0 when the key "prompt_eval_count" is absent. The scan skips spaces, colons, and line feeds after that key. The method returns 0 when no digit follows. The method accumulates the following digits into an int and returns that int.
      Parameters:
      body - The reply body. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the count, or 0 when the count is missing.
